title: Incremental Predictive Value of LLM Tutoring Interactions for Student Performance
abstract: arXiv:2610.33488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We evaluate whether semester-level interaction features from a large language model tutor improve assignment-score prediction beyond constant baselines. StudyChat provides 16,851 student-assistant exchanges from two offerings of an undergraduate artificial intelligence course, with outcomes matched to 175 of 203 student-semester records. Six fitted estimators and training-fold mean and median baselines share repeated nested cross-validation. After averaging each student's held-out predictions across ten repeats, Gradient Boosting achieves mean absolute error of 3.023 grade points, versus 3.138 for the median baseline. The paired difference is -0.114, with a conditional 95% bootstrap interval of [-0.245,0.013]. Representation changes and a semester-specific median yield similarly small gains. translated_title: LLM辅导互动对学生成绩的增量预测价值
translated_abstract: 我们评估来自大型语言模型辅导系统的学期级互动特征能否超越常数基线改进作业成绩预测。StudyChat数据集提供了来自两轮本科人工智能课程的16,851条学生-助手对话记录，其中203条学生-学期记录中有175条匹配到了成绩结果。六种拟合估计器与训练折均值和中位数基线共同采用重复嵌套交叉验证。在将每个学生的保留集预测在十次重复中取平均后，梯度提升模型实现了3.023个绩点的平均绝对误差，而中位数基线为3.138。配对差异为-0.114，其条件95%自助法置信区间为[-0.245, 0.013]。特征表示方式的变化以及学期特定的中位数基线也带来了同样微小的提升。然而，在观测分数最低的四分位组中，梯度提升的误差为7.30分，中位数基线为8.07分，均值基线为6.67分；岭回归具有最低……
tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了LLM辅导互动特征对学生成绩的增量预测价值，发现其总体上仅带来统计上不显著的边际改进，但对低分学生群体的预测误差有明显降低。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates whether LLM tutoring interaction features incrementally improve student score prediction, finding only marginal, statistically insignificant gains overall but notably reduced prediction error for low-scoring students.
